evidence.text: The file page identifies 唱-seal.svg as a digital vector depiction of 唱 in Shuowen seal-script style, names Sinica Database, Chinese Etymology, CUHK's Multi-function Chinese Character Database, and Chinese Text Project as source references, and releases the digital representation into the public domain. The file description does not make this an image of an ancient artifact.
evidence.title: File:唱-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The 昌-seal.svg page describes a digital vector of 昌 in Shuowen seal-script style, cites Sinica Database image 27.660C and Chinese Etymology image s04830 as specific references, and states CC0/public-domain reuse. Its file page links versions for earlier and later script traditions, but does not establish those versions' identity or date as forms of 唱.
evidence.title: File:昌-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

search_audit.query: Open the exact Wikimedia Commons description pages for 唱-seal.svg and 昌-seal.svg
search_audit.outcome: The 昌 page opened and its description, source references, direct-file link, and reuse statement were inspected. The 唱 page failed with a cache-miss error on direct open.

search_audit.query: Click actual original image and linked version pages from the 昌-seal.svg Commons description
search_audit.outcome: The direct original-file request returned HTTP 429. Linked period/category pages were inspected, but they did not identify a character-specific earlier 昌 glyph image suitable for this character's form history.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 唱-seal.svg; site:hanziyuan.net 唱 seal script; site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw 唱 27 image
search_audit.outcome: Search returned an indexed description of the exact 唱-seal.svg page, including its modern redraw status, cited source datasets, and public-domain statement. Attempting to resolve the original-file link via the web click tool did not resolve.

gaps: The indexed 唱-seal.svg description page established a usable image candidate and public-domain claim, but the browser could not open the page directly and did not resolve its direct image link. The harness-provided candidate URL returned a 404 on acquisition; no replacement direct image URL was verified, so this candidate is excluded pending a valid direct link.

The 昌-seal.svg description page opened and provided provenance and rights, but its direct file request returned 429. Linked earlier-script pages did not establish specific usable glyph candidates. No character-specific image for earlier forms of 唱 was verified.

No image pixels were inspected. Candidates below are based only on source-page descriptions; the seal-form image is explicitly a modern digital redraw, not an artifact photograph or scan. The available evidence supports only a proposed seal-style candidate for 唱, not a dated sequence of graphic change.

limitations.text: No usable direct image URL could be verified during this turn: 唱-seal.svg's exact Commons description was available through search indexing, but the page/direct-file could not be opened or resolved, and its supplied acquisition URL had previously returned 404. The 昌 seal image's direct file request returned 429. Therefore no image is proposed for download despite a well-described modern redraw candidate.
